verdict.rationale: Gemini in Firebase produces AI insights inside the Firebase console from the user's own data. For Crashlytics crashes it gives an issue description, possible root causes and fix suggestions, and for messaging campaigns it gives summaries and actionable recommendations, all through a natural-language chat interface. The MCP server and vector search are external or developer building blocks, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: evidence of AI insights over core app data (Firestore/Realtime Database contents, Analytics usage data) rather than only crashes and campaigns, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
